=== CALLEE SUMMARY ===
The method is supposed to convert an array of objects into an array of their corresponding classes.  
It operates on an input array of objects.  
It checks if the array is null or empty, then iterates over the array to get the class of each object.  
It outputs an array of Class objects corresponding to the input objects.  
At line 3, it calls ArrayUtils.EMPTY_CLASS_ARRAY. EMPTY_CLASS_ARRAY's intention is [PLACEHOLDER_NAME]
